//: Shared compiler options for every package in this monorepo. Standardized on module: esnext / moduleResolution: bundler for extensionless relative imports (the source-libs pattern). `lib: ["ES5"]` is the floor verified against every package that needs nothing more (case-converter, proxy-base needs ES2015 -- see its own override -- typed-pluralizer, set-immediate); every package that needs more states its own floor in its own tsconfig.ci.json, with the specific identifiers that set it named in a comment there. Never ESNext here -- each addition is per-package and justified. No rootDir/outDir/include/target-lib-DOM defaults here -- those are per-package concerns.
